definitions.def: a plan of action designed to achieve a long-term aim
to make someone want to have or do something
to break down food in the stomach so the body can use it
to begin to grow; to produce new shoots
showing a great deal of variety; very different from each other

grammar_choice.en_template: Throughout their long existence, they {{1:have created/have been created}} diverse survival {{2:strategies/strategy}}.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 긴 존속 기간 내내 식물은 다양한 생존 전략을 만들어 왔다.
explain: they가 전략을 '만드는' 주체 → 능동 현재완료 have created.
diverse(다양한)의 수식을 받는 복수 명사 → strategies.

grammar_choice.en_template: Seeds, in particular, {{1:are/is}} one of the strongest survival techniques {{2:they have developed/they have been developed}}.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 특히 씨앗은 식물이 발전시켜 온 가장 강력한 생존 기술 중 하나이다.
explain: 주어가 복수 Seeds → 복수 동사 are.
techniques를 수식하는 목적격 관계절(목적어 자리가 빔) → 능동 they have developed.

grammar_choice.en_template: Let's {{1:discover/discovering}} the fascinating and {{2:mysterious/mystery}} world of seeds.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 씨앗의 매혹적이고 신비로운 세계를 탐구해 보자.

grammar_choice.en_template: They offer tasty food to animals in return for {{1:distributing/distribute}} {{2:their/theirs}} seeds.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 식물은 씨앗을 퍼뜨려 주는 대가로 동물에게 맛있는 먹이를 제공한다.
explain: 뒤에 명사 seeds가 오므로 소유격 → their (theirs는 소유대명사).

grammar_choice.en_template: Jackfruit, the world's largest tree fruit, {{1:has/have}} a sweet smell {{2:that/what}} attracts animals, similar to pineapples and bananas.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 세계에서 가장 큰 나무 열매인 잭프루트는 파인애플이나 바나나와 비슷하게 동물을 끌어당기는 달콤한 냄새를 지니고 있다.
explain: 주어는 단수 Jackfruit(동격어구는 수에 영향 없음) → has.
선행사 a sweet smell을 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 → that (what은 선행사를 못 취함).

grammar_choice.en_template: It tempts animals {{1:to eat/eating}} delicious fruit flesh, thereby {{2:getting/get}} them to eat the seeds.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 잭프루트는 동물이 맛있는 과육을 먹도록 유혹하고, 그렇게 함으로써 동물이 씨앗까지 먹게 만든다.
explain: tempt + 목적어 + to V(5형식) → to eat.

grammar_choice.en_template: The fruit flesh {{1:is digested/digests}} by the animals that consume it, but the seeds are not digested and {{2:pass/passes}} through the animals' digestive tracts untouched.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 과육은 그것을 먹은 동물에게 소화되지만, 씨앗은 소화되지 않고 동물의 소화관을 손상되지 않은 채로 통과한다.
explain: 과육은 '소화되는' 대상이고 by ~가 이어짐 → 수동태 is digested.

grammar_choice.en_template: When these animals {{1:poop/pooped}} out the seeds, the seeds begin {{2:to sprout/sprouted}} and grow, and jackfruit spreads.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 이 동물들이 씨앗을 배설하면 씨앗은 싹트고 자라기 시작하며, 잭프루트가 퍼져 나간다.
explain: 일반적 사실을 말하는 시간 부사절 → 현재시제 poop.

grammar_choice.en_template: In exchange {{1:for/to}} a satisfying meal, the animals {{2:spread/spreads}} the jackfruit seeds.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 만족스러운 한 끼의 대가로 동물은 잭프루트 씨앗을 퍼뜨려 준다.
explain: in exchange for ~(~와 교환으로) 고정 표현 → for.

jumble.answer: Throughout their long existence, they have created diverse survival strategies.
Seeds, in particular, are one of the strongest survival techniques they have developed.
Let's discover the fascinating and mysterious world of seeds.
Plants will do anything to spread their seeds.
They offer tasty food to animals in return for distributing their seeds.
It tempts animals to eat delicious fruit flesh, thereby getting them to eat the seeds.
When these animals poop out the seeds, the seeds begin to sprout and grow, and jackfruit spreads.
In exchange for a satisfying meal, the animals spread the jackfruit seeds.
